item.title: ChroMapper 360/90 Support and Chroma 2.0 Lighting Released
item.description:
ChroMapper 360/90 Support and Chroma 2.0 Lighting Released

📢 New Features

ChroMapper, a Unity-based map editor for Beat Saber, has introduced 360/90 support for the first time ever in a community map editor, along with Chroma 2.0 Lighting.

🧩 Key Features

  • 360/90 Support for the first time ever in a community map editor
    • Chroma 2.0 Lighting brings lightshows to the next level
  • Optimized to run on a wide range of devices, from high-end VR machines to Chromebooks
  • Cross-platform, with official x64 builds available for Windows, Mac OS, and Linux
  • Individual users may also build ChroMapper for other platforms
  • Rebindable Keys means you can adapt your mapping workflow to whatever input device you have installed

⚙️ Technical Details

  • Developed with Unity in C#
  • Uses the GNU GPL v2 license
  • Builds are automatically created with Jenkins
  • GitHub Releases will be made with every stable update

🚀 Availability

  • Recommended installation method is through the ChroMapper Launcher, which auto-updates
  • x64 builds available for Windows, Mac OS, and Linux

💡 Support & Community

  • The ChroMapper Discord is the central point of communication between users and the developers
  • Atlas Rhythm provides a tutorial for new users
  • The ChroMapper Wiki offers documentation about the program, setup, and features
  • Localization updates are pulled from CrowdIn on a semi-occasional basis

🤝 Development & Contributions

  • Build guide available for setting up a development environment
  • Developers are encouraged to contribute under the GNU GPL v2 license
  • Patreon offers a way to support development and receive perks
  • CrowdIn allows users to help translate the application into other languages

#BeatSaber #MapEditor #Unity #VR #GameDevelopment #OpenSource

Source: Caeden117/ChroMapper

item.title: EyeDiT: Advancing 3D Eye Generation for AR/VR Applications
item.description:
EyeDiT: Advancing 3D Eye Generation for AR/VR Applications

Synthetic eye data are critical for rapid development of eye tracking (ET) in AR/VR applications. However, existing synthetic eye generators are largely image-centric and lack a high-quality underlying 3D anatomy of the eye, which limits their control mainly to the gaze and provides no anatomical labels.

🔍 Overview

  • Synthetic eye data are critical for rapid development of eye tracking (ET) in AR/VR applications.
  • Existing synthetic eye generators are largely image-centric and lack a high-quality underlying 3D anatomy of the eye.

🧩 How it works

  • EyeDiT is an anatomy-grounded, multi-modal 3D eye generation and simulation model trained with optical coherence tomography (OCT), labeled anatomy point clouds and near-eye images.
  • The pipeline first trains a Multi-Modal Anatomy Variational Autoencoder (VAE), which encodes an anatomy-aware latent representation from all input modalities.
  • Then, Eye Latent DiT is trained to generate latent samples conditioned on the optical axis, the pupil position and radius, and the subject identity.
  • The model enables control over the pupil, subject identity and viewpoint for data synthesis.

⚙️ Key details

  • The model outperforms previous eye image synthesis models in novel-view synthesis (24.9 against 21.8 dB PSNR from a single view).
  • A public ET neural network trained on EyeDiT’s synthetic data shows a smaller sim-to-real gap than when trained on data from other generators (3.5° vs. 8.4° gaze error).
  • The network approaches a network trained on real data, and further improves ET performance when combined with real data (2.3° vs. 2.6°).

🚀 Availability

  • More information is available on the project page: EyeDiT Project Page

💡 Why it matters

  • EyeDiT addresses the limitations of existing synthetic eye generators by providing a high-quality underlying 3D anatomy of the eye.
  • The model enables control over the pupil, subject identity and viewpoint for data synthesis, which is critical for rapid development of eye tracking (ET) in AR/VR applications.
  • The model outperforms previous eye image synthesis models and shows a smaller sim-to-real gap when used to train a public ET neural network.

#EyeTracking #ARVR #SyntheticData #3DEyeGeneration

Source: EyeDiT: Anatomy-Grounded Multi-Modal Eye Generation and Simulation

item.title: Meta Unveils New VR Glasses and Expanded Smart Glasses Lineup
item.description:
Meta Unveils New VR Glasses and Expanded Smart Glasses Lineup

During the annual Meta Connect showcase on Wednesday, Meta announced a slate of new wearables, including VR glasses, updated smart glasses, and a dedicated hardware device for its Muse AI agent.

👓 Meta VR Glasses

Meta is launching new VR hardware that packs virtual reality tech into a lightweight frame that sits on the ears like typical glasses rather than being strapped over the head.

  • Weight: 100g
  • Design: Uses a tethered computing puck in the pocket to distribute components.
  • Capabilities: Immersive displays for playing games, watching movies, and getting work done.
  • Content: Meta promises “hundreds” of movies in the US and “thousands of titles internationally” upon launch.

🕶️ Smart Glasses Lineup

Meta announced new screen-free smart glasses and updates to existing lines.

Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3

  • Styles: Includes a new aviator style with transition lenses and a geometric cat-eye frame called Zena.
  • Hardware: Features six microphones for clearer calls (up from five in the second generation).
  • Audio: All sound is captured in Dolby Atmos for spatial audio.
  • Battery: Nine hours of battery life.
  • Options: 27 color and lens combinations, plus three seasonal options.
  • Price: Starts at $449.

Ray-Ban Meta Audio Glasses

  • Features: Infused with Meta AI but contains no camera for recording others.
  • Weight: Audio-only models start at 43 grams.
  • Styles: Available in Clubmaster and Burbank styles.
  • Options: 23 color and lens combinations; supports the same wider prescription range as the Ray-Ban Meta Optics lineup.
  • Battery: Estimated 12 hours on a single charge.
  • Price: Starting price of $349.
  • Capabilities: Interacting with Meta AI, taking phone calls, and listening to podcasts or music.

Meta Glasses (Entry-Level)

  • New Styles: Capri and Nova.
  • Special Editions:
    • Kylie Jenner pair (ivory-colored): $399
    • Lisa (Blackpink) pair: Pink lenses and a blind-box-type charm styled after Lisa’s pets; starts at $399.
  • Standard Version: Non-celebrity versions start at $249.

🧩 AI and Accessibility Features

Meta is integrating the Muse AI agent into its smart glasses, allowing users to activate it by name for tasks such as logging meals, guiding workouts, or shopping assistance. Other updates include:

  • Hearing Enhancement: FDA-cleared software for adults with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss, available as a $149 add-on or via Meta One subscription.
  • Audio Customization: Users can shift volume between left and right ears, including sending all audio to one side.
  • Meta AI: Ability to provide “more context-rich answers” regarding what users are looking at.

⚙️ Muse Charm

Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for the Muse AI agent called Muse Charm.

  • Appearance: A large screen with a lanyard, resembling a chunky smart watch without the strap.
  • Interface: A fingerprint sensor on the top right corner to activate the agent.
  • Hardware: Includes a small camera and at least three microphones on the front.

🚀 Availability

Product Availability/Launch Date
Meta VR Glasses Spring 2027
Hearing Enhancement Feature Later this year

#Meta #MetaConnect #SmartGlasses #VR #ArtificialIntelligence
